text: S534 screened Open Patterns: the package parses ASTM/AAMA DXF into OPF and renders SVG/PNG but does not write DXF or provide a CAD receiver, so it cannot meet V03 round-trip acceptance. It may be a future one-way cross-check subject to rights review. No install, G04 data, or acceptance change. The next blocker is written CLO product-development permission and acceptable local-data handling, or a different rights-cleared free apparel CAD receiver/profile.
